summary: Build a complete data structure visualizer website that teaches data structure concepts through clear visual/animated explanations and provides an interactive playground for students, with a neat and easy-to-use UI.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Minimal academic logo mark with nodes-and-links motif (dsvis-logo.dim_512x512.png)
- Wide hero illustration showing abstract data structure shapes (arrays, nodes, tree) in a clean flat style (dsvis-hero.dim_1600x600.png)

existing_features.title: Create the core site structure for a complete Data Structure Visualizer website with clear navigation: Home, Data Structures, Algorithms, Playground, and About pages.
Implement a consistent, neat visual theme (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling) suitable for a student-focused educational tool, and apply it across all pages.

Build a “Concept Lessons” experience for data structures that explains concepts in English using concise text sections and a paired visual demo panel. Include at minimum: Array, Linked List, Stack, Queue, Binary Search Tree, Heap, and Graph.

Create an interactive Playground where students can manipulate a selected data structure and see updates visually. Provide controls for common operations (e.g., insert, delete, search/peek/pop/enqueue/dequeue as relevant), reset, and load a sample scenario.

Add step-by-step animation controls for visualizations: Play/Pause, Step Forward (and optional Step Back where feasible), and Speed control. Ensure operations are understandable (highlight active nodes/indices and show brief operation captions).
Implement algorithm visualizations (at minimum): Sorting (Bubble and Insertion) and Graph Traversal (BFS and DFS) with the same step/animation controls and clear highlighting of active elements.
Integrate the frontend with the backend using React Query for loading lesson content and presets, including loading and error UI states.
Ensure the UI is accessible and classroom-friendly: keyboard-operable controls, sufficient color contrast, readable font sizes, and clear empty states/tooltips for controls.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create a complete data structure visualizer website with clear visual/animated concept explanations and a neat UI.
Add an interactive playground where students can experiment with data structures visually (interactive controls and examples).

Add a backend content API in the single Motoko actor to serve curated lesson metadata and example presets used by the frontend (e.g., list of topics, per-topic lesson text sections, and sample input sets for the playground).

projectName: Data Structure Visualizer website with interactive playground and concept lessons
